title: have / has
grammarNote: Глагол "have" означает "иметь" и используется для описания того, что у тебя есть: семья, вещи, качества, животные. Важно: с местоимениями He / She / It глагол меняется на "has". Это такое же правило, как am/is/are!

grammarTable.subject: I / You / We / They
grammarTable.example: I have a sister. · We have a big family. · They have a dog.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It
grammarTable.example: She has a brother. · He has a cat. · It has a long tail.

grammarExtra.title: Negative form — don't have / doesn't have

rows.form: I / You / We / They + don't have
rows.example: I don't have a pet. · We don't have a garden.
She doesn't have a sister. · He doesn't have a car.
✗ She don't has a brother. ✓ She doesn't have a brother.

rows.form: Do I / you / we / they have...?
rows.example: Do you have a brother? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Does she have a pet? — Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
Do they have a garden? — Yes, they do.

rows.form: How many brothers do you have?
rows.example: I have one brother and one sister.
She has a cat and a small dog.

rows.form: How many people does your family have?

grammarTip:
Запомни: He / She / It → has (не have!)
Та же логика что и с "to be": I am → He is / I have → He has

I have = у меня есть · She has = у неё есть
I don't have = у меня нет · She doesn't have = у неё нет

exercises.text: I ___ two sisters and one brother.
My mother ___ a very stressful job.
Arman and Aizhan ___ the same grandmother.

exercises.hint: She → doesn't have. NEVER "she don't has".

exercises.text: "He don't have a sister" is correct English.
exercises.hint: He → He doesn't have a sister. Use "doesn't have" with He/She/It.
She → Does she have...? (not "Do she have")

exercises.instruction: Make a question. Fill in Do or Does.
exercises.hint: Grandparents = They → Do they have...? → Do your grandparents have...?
